name: LangChain
summary: Framework for building LLM applications and agents with integrations for models, vector stores and tools.
use_cases: RAG pipelines, tool-calling agents, prototyping across many model providers.
tradeoffs: Abstractions have changed frequently; pin versions.
Can add indirection compared with calling model SDKs directly.
avoid_if: you only need a single model call with a simple prompt.

name: LlamaIndex
summary: Data framework for connecting LLMs to your data: ingestion, indexing, retrieval and agents.
use_cases: Document question-answering, RAG over many data sources, knowledge assistants.
tradeoffs: Python package is more complete than the TypeScript one.
avoid_if: you are not doing retrieval over your own data.

name: AI SDK (Vercel)
summary: TypeScript toolkit for building AI features with a provider-agnostic API, streaming UI helpers and tool calling.
use_cases: Chat and generative UI in Next.js/React/Svelte apps, switching between model providers.

name: Ollama
summary: Tool for running open-weight LLMs and embedding models locally behind a simple REST API.
use_cases: Local or on-premises inference, privacy-sensitive prototypes, offline development.
tradeoffs: Quality and speed depend on your hardware and the open models you choose.
avoid_if: you need frontier-model quality without managing GPUs.

name: Voyage AI
summary: Embedding and reranking models (part of MongoDB) for retrieval and RAG.
use_cases: Semantic search, RAG retrieval quality, reranking search results; powers Atlas Automated Embedding.
tradeoffs: Managed API: data is sent to the provider for embedding.
avoid_if: embeddings must be computed entirely on your own hardware.

name: OpenAI API
summary: Managed API for OpenAI language, embedding, image and speech models with tool calling.
use_cases: Chat, summarisation, extraction, agents and embeddings without hosting models.
tradeoffs: Per-token pricing and data leaves your infrastructure.
avoid_if: inference must run on your own hardware.
